rootCauses.title: BigQuery public dataset top_terms coverage limitation
rootCauses.remediation: Honest INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE returned on missing terms; official Trends CSV Explore import path provided; zero synthetic points generated.

rootCauses.title: False positive provider diagnostics without verified credentials
rootCauses.remediation: GoogleFreeDemandProvider.diagnose() checks BIGQUERY_FREE_SANDBOX_VERIFIED and returns BLOCKED_FREE_SANDBOX_NOT_VERIFIED when unconfigured.

rootCauses.title: SerpApi provenance leakage in demand ingestion
rootCauses.remediation: DEMAND_PROVIDER_MODE=GOOGLE_FREE_ONLY sets methodologyVersion=google_free_demand_live and evidenceReference=GOOGLE_FREE_DEMAND_INGESTION; 0 SerpApi network calls made.

rootCauses.title: Trends CSV import lacked cryptographic disk integrity
rootCauses.remediation: Official Explore CSVs persisted to data/google_trends_imports/<sha256>.csv; verifyStoredCsvFile() validates physical file existence and recomputes SHA-256.

rootCauses.title: Google Trending Now RSS generated fake historical points
rootCauses.remediation: points: [] strictly enforced; trending signals strictly restricted to discovery, never Evergreen demand.

rootCauses.title: Google Ads Transparency lacked 1:1 creative association ledger
rootCauses.remediation: Forensic creativeAssociationLedger categorizes every creative as EXACT_PRODUCT_MATCH, PROBABLE_PRODUCT_MATCH, BRAND_ONLY_MATCH, or REJECTED_UNRELATED_CREATIVE.

rootCauses.title: G16 promoted unverified candidates without recovery
rootCauses.remediation: selectTopResearchShortlist() initiates merchant recovery and searches current-run candidates for VERIFIED replacements; records candidateRejectionLedger; fails closed if < 3 verified.

rootCauses.title: TikTok Organic was visible in navigation and active in discovery
rootCauses.remediation: TikTok Research nav item removed from Sidebar and Header; provider disabled in orchestrator.

rootCauses.title: Unapproved cloud spend risk
rootCauses.remediation: ZERO_SPEND_ENFORCED=true; dryRun query validation; strict zero-byte billing check; fails closed without credentials.

rootCauses.title: G15 Evergreen multi-scenario candidate summing
rootCauses.remediation: G15 evaluates candidate demand within a single research run, never summing across disjoint fallback and live runs.
